name: Denizen of the Deep
description:
Your body is adapted to life beneath the waves but is less graceful out of water.

You can breathe underwater and on land. While underwater, all your skills under BODY are favored and your Speed is doubled. While on land, all your skills under BODY are ill-favored and your Speed is reduced by 10 ft.

Additionally, your base Endurance is halved while on land. Applying fresh mammalian blood to your gills once per day removes this penalty.

Describe how your movement changes while in and out of water.
